brand-new-day-radio.description: A cinematic single-page music player for the Spider-Man: Brand New Day soundtrack — full-screen artwork, live clock, pulsing online pill, and keyboard shortcuts. No frameworks, no build step.

ai-landscape.description: AI Model Tracker — an overview of AI companies, models, and a retention framework, all in one landscape view.

loop-library.description: A library of 50 reusable loops for AI agents — each one tells an agent what to do, how to check its work, what to try next, and when to stop. Includes the installable Loopy skill and an agent guide.

loopy.description: Fork of the upstream Loopy project — the database-backed next-gen Loop Library. Kept as a fork with a daily auto-sync workflow so new upstream content flows in; the static site content is merged into loop-library.

video-shelf.description: A private YouTube video bookmark app — save videos by category with notes. Built with Vite, deployed on Vercel.
